claims.statement: Mandatory KSeF issuing began on 1 February 2026 for taxpayers above the stated 2024 sales threshold and on 1 April 2026 for most remaining taxpayers, while receiving through KSeF became mandatory on 1 February 2026.
KSeF assigns its unique number after accepting an invoice, returns that number in the UPO, and commercial accounting systems can connect through the KSeF API.
From February 2026, JPK VAT records require KSeF numbers or designated markings when a KSeF number is absent, creating a downstream reconciliation obligation.

contrary_evidence: The Ministry provides a taxpayer application, and established ERP vendors already cover ordinary sending, receiving, status display, and UPO download.
Taxpayers whose monthly invoiced sales stay at or below 10,000 PLN may issue outside KSeF through the end of 2026, narrowing the immediate smallest-business segment.
Official materials state there is no general duty to download and archive UPOs, so the offer must sell operational control rather than unnecessary document storage.

economics.acquisition_route: Founder-built exception guides and diagnostic checker, direct email to a bounded list of accounting offices, then ERP-implementer referrals
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Modeled path: 600 offices at 650 PLN average monthly recurring revenue equals 4.68m PLN ARR; a 35% owner-cash margin would be about 1.64m PLN/year, allowing cumulative founder cash above 10m PLN in roughly seven mature years without a sale
economics.founder_time: Up to 4.5 hours/day during MVP and pilots, falling toward 2 hours/day once onboarding and support are standardized
economics.gross_margin_basis: Modeled 85-92% software gross margin after API, storage, and support costs, excluding founder compensation
economics.payback: Target under 3 months if blended acquisition and onboarding labor stays below three months of first-year gross profit; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Modeled 299-1,499 PLN/month by managed-NIP tier plus 2,500-10,000 PLN for multi-ERP onboarding
economics.retention_or_repeat: Daily invoice flows and monthly tax close make the exception ledger recurrent; churn risk rises if native ERP controls become sufficient

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A growing rules-and-resolution corpus linking KSeF statuses, offline modes, ERP payload patterns, and successful remediation steps
fingerprint.customer: Polish accounting offices managing 20-300 taxpayer NIPs across heterogeneous invoicing and ERP tools
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Searchable Polish KSeF exception playbooks, targeted trials for accounting offices, and referrals from small ERP implementers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: API-connected reconciliation and exception SaaS with paid onboarding for ERP mappings and optional white-labelled client alerts
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The accounting office pays a monthly fee per managed-NIP tier when it needs a shared exception queue and evidence of resolution
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A submitted, received, corrected, or offline-mode invoice lacks a confirmed KSeF/JPK state before bookkeeping or tax-close deadlines

founder_fit: The core work is data reconciliation, anomaly detection, and workflow automation that fits an employed data scientist's strengths.
A narrow Polish-first product can be piloted asynchronously with a few accounting offices before any full-time commitment.
Recurring software revenue and content-led acquisition avoid a business built around the founder's public persona or daily meetings.
risks: Major Polish accounting platforms could add equivalent portfolio-level exception control quickly.
A mistaken status or JPK recommendation could create tax exposure and professional-liability claims.
KSeF API changes or outages could produce noisy alerts and intensive support precisely at filing peaks.

structure.commercial_archetype: Vertical compliance-operations SaaS priced by managed taxpayer portfolio
structure.control_point: The reconciliation ledger binding local invoice ID, KSeF number, UPO, JPK treatment, exception owner, and resolution timestamp
structure.critical_dependency: Reliable client-authorized KSeF API access and correct interpretation of evolving KSeF and JPK states

thesis: Build a Polish compliance-operations layer that watches invoice submissions and receipts across many taxpayer accounts, reconciles local invoice IDs to KSeF numbers and UPOs, and routes rejected, delayed, offline-mode, duplicate, and JPK-marking exceptions to a named owner. Accounting offices pay because the painful event is not ordinary invoice creation but proving that every client invoice reached the legally relevant state and was reflected correctly downstream.
title: KSeF Exception Ledger for Multi-Client Accounting Offices
uncertainties: The incidence and monetary cost of unresolved cross-system exceptions across accounting-office portfolios has not been measured.
Accounting offices' willingness to grant API permissions to an independent vendor is unknown.
The modeled price, conversion rate, support burden, churn, and owner-cash margin are assumptions requiring paid pilots.
